sources.title: Certified ratio conversion and nonlinear aggregation examples
sources.author: Causal banking research project

argument.anchor: Ratio error bound and noncommuting aggregation

inspected_anchors: Triangle-inequality ratio bound; monotonic interval division; exact two-group odds calculations
supported_claims: Ratio enclosure [3/14,5/6] despite point ratio 2/5; small absolute probability errors need not imply useful conditional precision.
Averaging probabilities gives 7/20, whereas averaging odds then transforming gives 5/13.
limits: Stipulated deterministic examples, not statistical coverage or engine qualification.
